args.prompt: @Video1 is a plain grey 3D clay render of ONE continuous drone shot, 17 seconds: it starts high over the Tel Aviv coast (Sde Dov), flies toward the Rainbow tower, a 39-floor residential tower wrapped in white undulating curved balcony slabs with planters and slim black glazing, descends along the facade to a terrace on the 16th floor, and glides through the open glass slider into the living room of the apartment. Re-render the SAME footage as photoreal video: keep every frame's camera motion, perspective, horizon and geometry exactly as in @Video1, only replace the clay materials with real ones. @Image1 is the real look of the exterior: white curved balconies, Mediterranean sea and beach, the Reading power-station chimney, low white buildings, trees and roads. @Image2 is the real look of the facade up close. @Image3 is the real look of the living room the camera enters: wide-plank pale oak parquet, warm white plaster walls, cream boucle curved sofa, round travertine table, jute rug, sand-grey kitchen, cream flush doors without frames, no skirting. Bright clear MORNING daylight throughout, sun high, neutral white light, blue sky, NO sunset or golden-hour tones. Smooth, continuous, no cuts, no text, no people, no watermark.
